description.text: Ong Lai Kopitiam brings the vibrant flavors of Malaysia to the heart of Canary Wharf. Rooted in the rich kopitiam café culture of Malaysia they serve heritage dishes that are as comforting as they are distinctive—from their signature blue rice Nasi Kerabu to street food favorites like Satay Chicken, Kolo Mee noodles, and the ever-loved Kaya Toast. More than just a place to eat, Ong Lai is a warm invitation to gather, connect, and discover the unique tastes of Malaysia, paired with the aroma of freshly brewed kopi and teh tarik. Whether you’re seeking a quick bite, a leisurely meal, or simply a taste of something new, Ong Lai Kopitiam offers an authentic dining experience that celebrates both tradition and community.
